name: The Gymnasium
hours: Physical Conditioning classes Tuesday Morning; open training Morning to Evening; Battle Team strength sessions before dawn.
sight: A high timber hall striped with court lines, climbing ropes and a bouldering wall whose holds are shaped like Gold coins and card symbols. One corner is free weights and battered punch bags; another, incongruously, a ring of duel tables on rubber matting, where people play with their pulse still at 150. Coach Rox's whistle cuts through everything. It smells of rubber, chalk and effort.
things: Attend Physical Conditioning (and discover why a card school has one)
Run intervals, then play a timed hand with shaking fingers — the 'heartbeat drill'
Lift with Baylee, who spots for anyone and says nothing about the weights
Hit the bag after a bad loss
Watch the Battle Team's dawn session through the door glass
Read the tryout notice and the standards sheet pinned beside it
Ask Coach Rox what she looks for in a reserve
secret: Conditioning is the mechanical remedy for Rowan's low Nerve: the heartbeat drill converts fitness into steadier hands (technique 'Box Breath'). Battle Team open tryouts Day 33 are announced here; the result is posted on Day 34. Rox judges people by what they do when exhausted; she is the staff member least impressed by Lilia's legend and most protective of Willas. Stage D: after each team member's incident her standards sheet loses a name; she never takes the sheet down. Priya trains here at dawn; Sunny between pool shifts.
